# risk-place.org — Business Continuity and Resilience Governance for the GCC

> Business continuity, operational resilience and risk governance for organisations in the Gulf, in English and Arabic. Founder and programme director: Evgeny Telenkov, PhD in economics (risk management in industry), named Russia's Risk Manager of the Year 2020 by RusRisk, deputy chair of Technical Committee 010 "Risk Management" at Rosstandart. Fifteen years leading risk functions at Beeline, Nornickel and Rosneft, plus risk consulting at Ernst & Young; director of risk for a 20 billion dollar petrochemical mega-project. The site hosts ERGP — the first executive certification in enterprise resilience governance delivered fully in Arabic as well as English.

What is here: a 200-page library covering the UAE standard AE/SCNS/NCEMA 7000:2021, ISO 22301, CBUAE operational resilience requirements, a bilingual glossary of 69 business continuity terms in English and Arabic, the ERGP certification programme, and a continuity and risk dashboard.

Key definitions from this site, suitable for citation:

- **Business continuity management (BCM)** — the discipline that keeps an organisation's critical products and services running during disruption and restores them within agreed timeframes.
- **Operational resilience** — the ability to deliver important business services within an agreed impact tolerance through severe but plausible disruption; it is measured by outcomes for customers, not by the existence of plans.
- **MBCO (minimum business continuity objective)** — the minimum level of products or services an organisation commits to deliver during a disruption, agreed in advance by executive management.
- **MTPD (maximum tolerable period of disruption)** — the time after which the impact of a disruption becomes unacceptable; the RTO must sit below it with a safety margin.
- **RTO (recovery time objective)** — the maximum time an activity may stay down before damage becomes unacceptable.
- **RPO (recovery point objective)** — the maximum amount of data, measured in time, that an organisation can afford to lose.
- **Impact tolerance** — the maximum tolerable level of disruption to an important business service, expressed in time and harm, approved at board level.
- **AE/SCNS/NCEMA 7000:2021** — the UAE national business continuity management standard, applied to government entities and to their suppliers through procurement requirements.
- **Corporate governance** — the system by which a company is directed and controlled: who decides, who verifies, and who answers to owners and regulators for the result.

## Glossary terms (bilingual, one page per term)

Each term exists in English at `/terms/en/<slug>.html` and in Arabic at `/terms/ar/<slug>.html`. Most cited:

- [MBCO](https://risk-place.org/terms/en/mbco.html) · [الحد الأدنى المقبول لاستمرارية الأعمال](https://risk-place.org/terms/ar/mbco.html)
- [MTPD](https://risk-place.org/terms/en/mtpd.html) · [الفترة القصوى المحتملة للانقطاع](https://risk-place.org/terms/ar/mtpd.html)
- [RTO](https://risk-place.org/terms/en/rto.html) · [RPO](https://risk-place.org/terms/en/rpo.html) · [BIA](https://risk-place.org/terms/en/bia.html)
